name: Kirchberg

meta.title: Cleaning services in Kirchberg
meta.description: Office cleaning for financial and corporate premises, and home cleaning for apartments on the Kirchberg plateau in Luxembourg City.

intro: On the Kirchberg plateau, offices and new residential buildings sit side by side. We clean both, to the standards each one requires.
paragraphs: Kirchberg is home to European institutions, banks and corporate headquarters, as well as a growing number of apartment buildings. Many premises have strict access procedures and expect cleaning to happen outside working hours.

For businesses, we provide vetted staff, documented key and badge protocols and evening or early-morning schedules. For residents, we offer regular home cleaning and end-of-tenancy cleans for the many apartments that change hands each year.

faq.question: Can you work with our building's security procedures?
faq.answer: Yes. We review your access, badge and visitor procedures during onboarding and follow them on every visit.
